title: Integrations
workitemDescription: Configure external work item credentials and managed projects. Aone is currently supported.
channelsDescription: Connect Agents to messaging channels so group members can @mention an Agent to chat.
channelsFailed: Failed to load collaboration channels. Refresh and try again.
unavailableChannel: This channel is not available yet
runtimeDrainingHint: This channel is finishing messages it already received and will stop accepting new ones afterwards.
runtimePausedHint: The platform switched to another channel. This channel no longer accepts new messages, while received messages still finish delivery.
runtimeDisabledHint: The platform has not enabled the shared group bot for this channel, so @mentions in groups are not received.
runtimeErrorHint: The shared group bot configuration is not ready. Ask a platform administrator to check the app credentials.
selectProjectFirst: Select at least one managed project first
firstImportHelp: Configure platform credentials and managed projects before the first import. The external platform is the source of truth for requirements, defects, tasks, comments and statuses. Local comments are written back with a platform signature.
requiredProjects: Select at least one managed project
projectPlaceholder: Search first, then select managed projects
issueIdsHint: Enter external work item IDs separated by commas; leave blank to sync all work items in managed projects
outboxCommand: Process the work item writeback queue
agentPlaceholder: Select an Agent in this tenant
defaultPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the default
dingCallback: Callback URL (copy to the DingTalk bot console)
dingDescription: Bind a DingTalk bot to an Agent. Group members can @mention the bot to have multi-turn conversations with the Agent.
dingEmpty: No bindings yet. Select “New binding” to connect your first DingTalk bot.
feishuSaved: Feishu binding saved. Configure the callback URL and publish the Feishu app.
feishuDescription: Receives messages through HTTP callbacks. Supports text in direct chats and multi-turn conversations when @mentioned in groups, with text replies. Enable the bot in the Feishu Open Platform and configure an online Executor for the Agent first.
feishuDeleteHelp: This app will stop receiving and replying to messages.
validAppId: Enter a valid App ID starting with cli_
keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the existing secret
keepToken: Leave blank to keep the existing Token
tokenHelp: Find this under “Events & callbacks → Encryption strategy” in the Feishu app
keepEncryption: Encryption is configured; leave blank to keep the existing key
encryptionHelp: Optional. Match the Feishu encryption strategy; when configured, signatures are verified and events decrypted.
clearEncryption: Clear Encrypt Key (also disable encryption in Feishu)
existingBindingOpened: This group already has a binding. Its details were opened instead of creating another one.
groupIdGuideIntro: First add the platform group-chat bot to the target group.
groupIdGuideStepAt: ① In the target group, type @ and select the group-chat bot from the list.
groupIdGuideStepInfo: ② Then type “{{command}}” and send it.
groupIdGuideStepCopy: ③ Copy the complete group ID from the bot reply and paste it below.
groupIdGuideDingTalk: The group ID is the message conversationId (usually starting with cid), not the numeric group number shown in the UI.
groupIdGuideFeishu: The group ID is the chat_id (starting with oc_). Configure event subscriptions and the required permissions in Feishu first.
groupIdGuideUnresponsive: If the bot does not reply, check the platform channel, group-chat bot configuration and connection/callback status first.
platformChannelAccessHint: This is the state the platform configuration permits. It does not mean every group is confirmed, nor that every message is processed or delivered successfully.
detailNoSecret: No secrets are shown in details.
noGroupIdIdentity: No group ID (bound by application identity)
deleteHelp: Deleting this binding stops its group-chat service immediately and cannot be undone.
conflictLegacyBody: This bot configuration already exists in a Workspace. Delete the group-chat bot configuration in that original Workspace first.
conflictLegacyRestricted: Another Workspace you cannot view also uses this configuration. Contact its administrator.
conflictLegacyUnavailable: The Workspace using this configuration was deleted or its entry is unavailable. Contact its administrator.
conflictLegacyDeleteImpact: Deleting the original binding interrupts its group-chat service.
conflictNotify: Notification and group-chat bots must use different application identities.
conflictShared: This application identity is already used by the platform group-chat bot; use another identity.
conflictUnknown: Bot identity conflict. Check the configuration and try again.
sharedBindingHint: Shared group-chat bindings use the platform bot. Enter only the group ID and Agent; the binding works as soon as it is saved.
groupIdHelp: External group ID; leading and trailing whitespace is ignored.
legacyEditHint: This legacy standalone bot keeps its original application credentials and can only edit existing fields. Creating new standalone bindings is closed.
feishuCallback: Callback URL (copy to Feishu event subscriptions)
feishuSetup: After saving, select “Send events to developer server” in Feishu, enter the public HTTPS callback URL and subscribe to “Receive message im.message.receive_v1”. Enable permissions to read direct messages sent to the bot, receive group messages that @mention the bot and send messages as the app. Publish the app and add the bot to the group.
